name: sharetribe
description: Guided assistant for non-technical users working on the Sharetribe web template — helps with setup, deployment, and building new features.

interface.shortDescription: Setup, deploy, and build features on your Sharetribe marketplace
interface.longDescription: Sharetribe Skills helps non-technical users work on their Sharetribe web template marketplace. Get step-by-step guidance for first-time local setup, deploying to staging on Render, committing and pushing changes, and building new features or customizations.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up the Sharetribe web template for the first time.
I want to deploy my marketplace to staging.
I want to add a feature to my marketplace.
